upstream.description: Router that virtually distributes inference across connected devices in the home.

classification.analysis: NVIDIA Personal AI Router (PAIR) is a local inference router that pairs multiple Windows/Linux/macOS machines on a home network and routes each independent inference request to whichever paired node has a compatible engine, the requested model, and available capacity. It presents Ollama-compatible and OpenAI-compatible proxy endpoints so existing apps and agents work unchanged, can auto-install and manage the Ollama or LM Studio engines on each node, and ships as a signed cross-platform desktop app (Electron front end, Go services, native macOS/Windows privileged helpers) plus a terminal interface for headless machines. It targets home-lab users running concurrent local LLM workloads, such as multi-agent applications, who want to pool spare GPU machines without prompts or models leaving the LAN; it explicitly does not shard a model or pool GPU memory across nodes.

use_cases.title: Route local LLM requests across multiple home-network machines by availability
Keep prompts and models entirely on the local network instead of the cloud
Point an existing Ollama- or OpenAI-compatible client at a pooled multi-machine backend
Run concurrent multi-agent workloads across spare home GPUs
